title: TurnEvent
description: The alerting event: this session's turn state changed. state == awaiting or idle is what buzzes the wrist; NotificationTransport consumes exactly this.

requestId.description: The request that is blocking, when reason is ask or permission. Carried into the notification's RemoteInput so a dictated reply from the shade resolves this exact request.

sessionName.description: Denormalised so a notification can be built from the turn event alone.

summary.description: One line, already shortened for a 1.5" screen.
